description: This PHP source file defines the MessagesApiController class, which handles API endpoints related to project messages and comments within the Goteo crowdfunding platform. It includes methods for listing, adding, deleting, and managing messages and comments, as well as project mailing functionalities.

classes.name: MessagesApiController
classes.description: Controller class handling API endpoints for project messages and comments, including listing, adding, deleting, and mailing functionalities.

methods.name: commentsAction
methods.description: Lists comments for a specific project, with permission check.

methods.name: addCommentAction
methods.description: Adds a new comment or reply to a message thread, with permission and validation checks.

methods.name: deleteCommentAction
methods.description: Deletes a specific comment after permission validation.

methods.name: messagesAction
methods.description: Lists all messages for a project, with permission check.

methods.name: userMessagesAction
methods.description: Lists messages for a specific user within a project, with permission check.

methods.name: addMessageAction
methods.description: Adds a new message to a project, with recipient handling and permission validation.

methods.name: projectMailingAction
methods.description: Retrieves mailing statistics and details for project messages, with permission check.
